description: Typed engineering/research prerequisite map, NOT a graph of proved logical implications. requires_any is OR of AND groups. Proof gates may depend on engineering audits; statuses refer only to scope, not promotion of descendants. Q05 is OPTIONAL theorem-prover hardening; a sound human-checkable analytic proof is not invalid solely because it is not machine-formalized.

edge_semantics.requires_all: Research prerequisites that must be specified and established for this planned route, not logical necessity in every conceivable proof.
edge_semantics.requires_any: Alternative groups, each of which is an AND list; at least one group must be discharged.
edge_semantics.nonimplication: An exact finite positivity, a symmetric completion, a half-density representation, or formal coherence never alone implies an RH sign.
